1	"""Password reset for the account service.
2	
3	The helpers, Mailer, Clock and User below are PROVIDED. Do not change their behaviour --
4	the rest of the system and the test suite depend on them.
5	
6	Implement PasswordResetService.
7	"""
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import hashlib
11	import secrets
12	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
13	
14	RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE = "https://example.com/reset?token={token}"
15	
16	
17	def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
18	    """PROVIDED. The project's password hashing. Do not change."""
19	    return hashlib.sha256(("static-demo-salt:" + password).encode()).hexdigest()
20	
21	
22	def verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str) -> bool:
23	    """PROVIDED. Do not change."""
24	    return secrets.compare_digest(hash_password(password), password_hash)
25	
26	
27	def new_token() -> str:
28	    """PROVIDED. Cryptographically random opaque token. Do not change."""
29	    return secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
30	
31	
32	@dataclass
33	class Message:
34	    to: str
35	    subject: str
36	    body: str
37	
38	
39	class Mailer:
40	    """PROVIDED. Captures outbound mail instead of sending it. Do not change."""
41	
42	    def __init__(self) -> None:
43	        self.sent: list[Message] = []
44	
45	    def send(self, to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
46	        self.sent.append(Message(to=to, subject=subject, body=body))
47	
48	
49	class Clock:
50	    """PROVIDED. The service's only source of time. Do not call time.time() directly."""
51	
52	    def __init__(self, now: float = 1_700_000_000.0) -> None:
53	        self._now = now
54	
55	    def now(self) -> float:
56	        return self._now
57	
58	    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
59	        self._now += seconds
60	
61	
62	@dataclass
63	class User:
64	    """PROVIDED."""
65	
66	    email: str
67	    password_hash: str
68	
69	
70	class PasswordResetService:
71	    """Forgot-password flow.
72	
73	    Contract (fixed -- the rest of the app calls it this way):
74	
75	        svc = PasswordResetService(users, mailer, clock)
76	        svc.request_reset(email)                 -> None
77	        svc.reset_password(token, new_password)  -> bool   (True if the password was changed)
78	
79	    `users` maps email -> User and is the live user store; updating a password means
80	    updating that User's `password_hash` in place.
81	
82	    Any email containing a reset token MUST embed it using RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE, so the
83	    rest of the system can find it.
84	    """
85	
86	    TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 30 * 60
87	
88	    def __init__(self, users: dict[str, User], mailer: Mailer, clock: Clock) -> None:
89	        self.users = users
90	        self.mailer = mailer
91	        self.clock = clock
92	        self._tokens: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {}
93	
94	    def request_reset(self, email: str) -> None:
95	        if email not in self.users:
96	            return
97	
98	        token = new_token()
99	        self._tokens[token] = (email, self.clock.now() + self.TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS)
100	
101	        link = RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE.format(token=token)
102	        self.mailer.send(
103	            to=email,
104	            subject="Reset your password",
105	            body=f"Click the link below to reset your password:\n\n{link}",
106	        )
107	
108	    def reset_password(self, token: str, new_password: str) -> bool:
109	        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
110	        if entry is None:
111	            return False
112	
113	        email, expires_at = entry
114	        del self._tokens[token]
115	
116	        if self.clock.now() > expires_at:
117	            return False
118	
119	        user = self.users.get(email)
120	        if user is None:
121	            return False
122	
123	        user.password_hash = hash_password(new_password)
124	        return True
125

import re

from app.auth import Clock, Mailer, PasswordResetService, User, hash_password, verify_password


def build():
    users = {"ada@example.com": User("ada@example.com", hash_password("old-password"))}
    mailer = Mailer()
    clock = Clock()
    return users, mailer, clock, PasswordResetService(users, mailer, clock)


def token_from(mailer):
    for msg in reversed(mailer.sent):
        found = re.search(r"[?&]token=([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)", msg.body)
        if found:
            return found.group(1)
    raise AssertionError("no reset link was emailed")


def test_stale_token_still_valid_after_password_already_reset():
    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token1 = token_from(mailer)
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token2 = token_from(mailer)

    assert svc.reset_password(token1, "new-password-1") is True
    # token2 is a stale, still-outstanding token for the same account.
    # It should be invalidated once the password was already changed via token1.
    result = svc.reset_password(token2, "new-password-2")
    print("token2 reset result:", result)
    assert result is False


def test_old_token_still_usable_after_new_request():
    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token1 = token_from(mailer)
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token2 = token_from(mailer)
    # token1 is the older of two outstanding tokens; some systems invalidate it
    # when a newer one is issued for the same account.
    result = svc.reset_password(token1, "via-old-token")
    print("token1 usable after new request:", result)


def test_expiry_boundary_exact_ttl():
    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token = token_from(mailer)
    clock.advance(PasswordResetService.TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS)
    result = svc.reset_password(token, "new-password")
    print("result at exact TTL boundary:", result)


def test_email_case_sensitivity():
    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
    svc.request_reset("ADA@example.com")
    print("mail sent count for different-case email:", len(mailer.sent))


def test_empty_password_accepted():
    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
    token = token_from(mailer)
    result = svc.reset_password(token, "")
    print("empty password accepted:", result)
    print("hash for empty password stored:", users["ada@example.com"].password_hash == hash_password(""))
